title: FirstMate to ASB routing-request builder (Phase 3 seam)
mission: Own the read-only asb.agent-observation/v1 to prompt-kit.routing-request/v1 translation seam (ASB cross-product-translation) so a correlated observation can be turned into a bounded routing request, without selecting prompts, consulting a registry, dispatching, rolling over, or scheduling crew.
safeParallelWork: Unrelated Windows profile or OpenCode LSP work
forbiddenScope: prompt selection / registry consultation / routing decision consumer
prompt dispatch, context rollover, or automatic transition
new ASB crew scheduler or watcher
fm-send / fm-control / tmux probing / direct terminal manipulation
live prompt dispatch or credential automation
upstream FirstMate mutation or pin bump
committing machine-local receipts, secrets, or personal FirstMate home state
expectedArtifacts: routing-request builder round-trip assertions in the protocol contract test
